Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring coordination between local government and public utilities in the design and relocation of water and sewer systems.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the coordination of water and sewer systemutilities; adding a new section to chapter 35.21 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 36.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Cities shall, in the predesign phase of construction projectsinvolving the relocation of either water or sewer facilities, or both,consult with public utilities operating either water or sewer systems,or both, in order to coordinate design.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Counties shall, in the predesign phase of construction projectsinvolving the relocation of either water or sewer facilities, or both,consult with public utilities operating either water or sewer systems,or both, in order to coordinate design.
